subject: Conflux Summit: brand guardrails, keynote swap contingency & trade plan
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@lumasync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Voss <m.voss@conflux.events>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2026 16:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood sponsorship package — quick clarifications

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for sending the draft package. A couple quick items from our side as we work toward finalizing SOW: 

1) Keynote swap contingency: We appreciate the flexibility on slot timing. If your keynote needs to move (production delays, last-minute speaker availability), can we lock in an alternate 30-minute plenary slot the morning of the second day? We need a written fallback so we can adjust program printing and signage.

2) Brand guardrails: Our partners legal want explicit logo treatment language — minimum clear space, background alternatives (full-color on white, single-color reversed allowed only on black stage treatments), and a prohibition on using the Redwood mark in press releases without joint approval.

3) Press timing: Conflux prefers to have any sponsor-led press announced only after speaker confirmation, so that we don’t run conflicting PR on the same day as a keynote change.

I attached our standard speaker rider and the contracts email for the legal team.

If you can share a short trade plan for the trade of the keynote vs. demo pavilion rights (we discussed earlier), that would help speed approvals on our end.

Best,
Elena
Elena Soto
Director, Sponsorships — Conflux Events
elena@lumasync.com

> 1) Keynote swap contingency: written fallback to a morning plenary if keynote moves.
> 2) Brand guardrails: explicit logo treatment language (clear space, allowed backgrounds, press use restrictions).
> 3) Press timing: no sponsor-led PR until speaker confirmed.

My read: we can accept the morning-plenary fallback but should get the trade plan explicit (demo pod hours + branded lounge + 45min roundtable). Also need to be strict about press timing — we can coordinate an embargo-friendly announcement.

Open questions: 
- Kimberly: can Ops guarantee the extra 2 demo hours and the lounge footprint? (we've committed lounge already but hours and staffing need sign-off)
- Dylan: what's the incremental ops cost for a 45-minute roundtable (seating, A/V, staffing)?
- Aditya: legal wants the exact logo spec to add to the SOW — I can propose our standard 4x clearspace and color variants; any changes we should push back on?

Objective: craft a concise reply that (a) accepts the contingency with the exact trade deliverables listed and (b) proposes logo language that satisfies Conflux legal without loosening our brand use.

Marissa

From: Elena Soto <elena@lumasync.com>

Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2026 11:37:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Conflux Summit: brand guardrails, keynote swap contingency & trade plan

Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turn. All looks reasonable. A few final bullets from our legal and programming team before we route for signature: 

• Conflux will document the morning-plenary fallback as: "In the event the contracted keynote is rescheduled by the sponsor within 14 days of the event start, Conflux will provide the sponsor a 30-minute morning plenary slot on day two, subject to program availability."
• We’ll accept your proposed trade deliverables (2 demo hours, branded lounge, 45-minute roundtable) but need the operational conditions Kimberly mentioned included as an SOW attachment.
• Logo guardrails: Conflux legal requests a one-sentence addition: "Sponsor agrees not to use event marks in press releases promoting product launches without prior written consent from Conflux." We are okay with a 4x clearspace and the two background variants you provided.
• Press embargo: Conflux will require a 24-hour coordination window for any sponsor press tied to a keynote announcement.

Please upload the updated SOW (with the Operations Conditions attachment and revised logo clause) to the DocuSign link and notify contracts@conflux.events. Once we have the signed SOW, Conflux will proceed with program printing and press calendar entries.

I'll attach the signed rider on our end after legal runs the final doc. Looking forward to seeing Redwood on stage.

Best,
Elena
